name: Khajuraho Group of Temples
description: The Khajuraho Group of Monuments are famous for their Nagara-style architectural symbolism and intricate erotic rock sculptures. Built during the Chandela dynasty between 950 and 1050 AD, it is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
short_description: UNESCO world heritage site famous for intricate Nagara architectural stone carvings and ancient temples.

name: Sanchi Stupa
description: Great Stupa at Sanchi is one of the oldest stone structures in India and an important monument of Indian Architecture. It was originally commissioned by the emperor Ashoka in the 3rd century BCE.
short_description: Ancient Buddhist stupa commissioned by Emperor Ashoka featuring ornamental stone torana gateways.

name: Gwalior Fort & Man Singh Palace
description: Gwalior Fort is an 8th-century hill fort near Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh. Described by Mughal emperor Babur as the pearl among fortresses of India, it houses the turquoise-tiled Man Singh Palace.
short_description: Imposing hilltop fortress housing turquoise-tiled royal palaces and ancient rock statues.

name: Kanha National Park & Tiger Reserve
description: Kanha Tiger Reserve is one of the tiger reserves of India and the largest national park of Madhya Pradesh. It is home to Bengal tigers, Indian leopards, and the rare Barasingha swamp deer.
short_description: Vast sal forest tiger reserve inspired Rudyard Kiplings Jungle Book.

name: Pachmarhi Hill Station & Bee Falls
description: Pachmarhi is a hill station in Hoshangabad district of Madhya Pradesh state. It is widely known as Satpura ki Rani (Queen of Satpura), situated at a height of 1,067 m.
short_description: Serene Satpura mountain hill station featuring waterfalls, ancient caves, and pine forests.

name: Bhedaghat Marble Rocks & Dhuandhar Falls
description: Bhedaghat is famous for high marble rocks soaring along the Narmada River. Moonlight boating between the marble cliffs and Dhuandhar waterfall are premier attractions.
short_description: Soaring white marble canyon cliffs along Narmada river with misty roaring waterfalls.

name: Statue of Unity & Kevadia
description: The Statue of Unity is the world's tallest statue, with a height of 182 metres, depicting Indian statesman and independence activist Vallabhbhai Patel. Set against the Narmada river Dam.
short_description: Worlds tallest 182-meter colossal statue and eco-tourist complex on the Narmada riverbank.

name: Rann of Kutch Salt Desert
description: The Great Rann of Kutch is a salt marsh in the Thar Desert in Kutch District. It transforms into a vast shimmering white salt desert, host to the famous Rann Utsav cultural festival.
short_description: Vast endless white salt desert offering surreal moonlit night views and vibrant folk culture.

name: Gir National Park Asiatic Lions
description: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary is a forest and wildlife sanctuary in Gujarat, India. Established in 1965, it is the sole natural home of the endangered Asiatic Lion.
short_description: Sole natural sanctuary in the world home to wild Asiatic Lions and dry deciduous teak forests.

name: Somnath & Dwarka Sacred Temples
description: Somnath Temple is the first among the twelve Jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva. Located on the western coast of Gujarat, it overlooks the Arabian Sea.
short_description: Sacred coastal pilgrimage site with rich spiritual history overlooking the Arabian Sea.

name: Amer Fort
description: Amer Fort is a majestic fortress situated high on a hill in Amer, Rajasthan. Known for its artistic style elements, large ramparts, series of gates, and cobbled paths, it overlooks Maota Lake.
short_description: Majestic hilltop palace fort overlooking Maota Lake with opulent mirror halls and royal architecture.

name: City Palace Jaipur
description: The City Palace, Jaipur was established at the same time as the city of Jaipur itself, by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, who moved his court to Jaipur from Amber in 1727.
short_description: Iconic royal complex blending Rajasthani and Mughal architecture in the heart of Jaipur.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Hawa Mahal is a palace in Jaipur, India built from red and pink sandstone. It sits on the edge of the City Palace, Jaipur, and extends to the Zenana.
short_description: The Palace of Breeze featuring 953 intricate honeycomb windows.

name: Mehrangarh Fort
description: Mehrangarh Fort covers an area of 1,200 acres in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. The complex is located on a hilltop around 122 metres above the surrounding plain.
short_description: Formidable hilltop citadel with expansive courtyards and panoramic views of the Blue City.

name: Jaisalmer Fort
description: Jaisalmer Fort is situated in the city of Jaisalmer, in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is believed to be one of the very few living forts in the world.
short_description: A living golden fort rising from the Thar Desert with bustling shops and ancient Jain temples.

name: Pushkar Holy Lake & Brahma Temple
description: Pushkar is a sacred town in Rajasthan surrounding Pushkar Lake, a sacred Hindu site with 52 ghats. It houses one of the very few temples dedicated to Lord Brahma.
short_description: Sacred lakeside pilgrimage town known for its spiritual ghats and vibrant camel fair history.

name: Bundi Garh Palace
description: Garh Palace in Bundi is famous for its exquisite Rajput frescoes, intricate murals, and serene stepwells, away from heavy tourist crowds.
short_description: Offbeat historic palace famous for vibrant royal frescoes and ancient stepwells.

name: Alleppey Backwaters
description: The Alleppey backwaters consist of a seamless network of brackish lagoons and lakes parallel to the Arabian Sea. Renting a traditional houseboat offers a tranquil journey through palm-fringed canals.
short_description: Serene canal network fringed by coconut palms and tranquil houseboat cruises.

name: Munnar Tea Gardens
description: Munnar is a town and hill station located in the Idukki district of the southwestern Indian state of Kerala. It is renowned for lush rolling tea plantations and mist-covered hills.
short_description: Rolling green tea estates, misty valleys, and cool mountain air in the Western Ghats.

name: Varkala Cliff Beach
description: Varkala Beach is the only place in southern Kerala where cliffs are found adjacent to the Arabian Sea. These Cenozoic sedimentary formation cliffs are a unique geological feature.
short_description: Unique coastal cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea with beachside cafes and mineral springs.

name: Fort Kochi & Chinese Net Coast
description: Fort Kochi is a coastal neighborhood filled with colonial history, Portuguese architecture, art cafes, and iconic Chinese fishing nets along the coastline.
short_description: Charming heritage quarter with colonial mansions, vibrant art scene, and iconic fishing nets.

name: Gavi Eco-Tourism Reserve
description: Gavi is a pristine forest reserve inside Periyar Tiger Reserve. It offers regulated eco-tourism, bamboo rafting, forest treks, and wildlife spotting.
short_description: Untouched tropical rain forest offering bamboo rafting and endangered wildlife sightings.

name: Solang Valley
description: Solang Valley offers adventure activities like paragliding, zorbing, skiing, and cable car rides amidst snow-capped Himalayan peaks.
short_description: Premier adventure hub in Manali for paragliding, skiing, and snow activities.

name: Rohtang Pass
description: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas around 51 km from Manali. It connects the Kullu Valley with Lahaul and Spiti Valleys.
short_description: Breathtaking high-altitude Himalayan mountain pass offering glacier views and snow play.

name: Spiti Valley Key Monastery
description: Key Monastery is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery located on top of a hill at an altitude of 4,166 metres above sea level, close to the Spiti River.
short_description: Ancient cliffside Buddhist monastery set against dramatic cold desert landscapes.

name: Jibhi & Tirthan Valley
description: Jibhi is a quiet, idyllic village tucked in Tirthan Valley, surrounded by pine forests, wooden cottages, and sparkling rivers. Ideal for slow travel.
short_description: Quiet mountain hideaway with wooden chalets, pine forests, and crystal clear trout streams.

name: Calangute & Baga Beach
description: Calangute and Baga are famous beaches in North Goa known for golden sand, water sports, beach shacks, seafood, and energetic nightlife.
short_description: Vibrant beach strip famous for water sports, beach shacks, seafood, and nightlife.

name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls
description: Dudhsagar Falls is a four-tiered waterfall located on the Mandovi River. It is among India's tallest waterfalls, cascading through dense Bhagwan Mahaveer Sanctuary.
short_description: Spectacular four-tiered milk-white waterfall cascading through tropical jungle.

name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter
description: Fontainhas is an old Latin Quarter in Panaji known for colorful Portuguese houses, narrow streets, quaint cafes, and art galleries.
short_description: Historic heritage neighborhood with pastel Portuguese mansions, cafes, and art galleries.

name: Taj Mahal
description: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum on the right bank of the river Yamuna in Agra. Commissioned in 1631 by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, it is a UNESCO World Heritage site and global icon.
short_description: World-famous marble monument of eternal love and Mughal architectural masterpiece.

name: Kashi Vishwanath & Ganga Ghats
description: Varanasi is one of the oldest continually inhabited cities in the world. The evening Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat and early morning boat ride are unforgettable spiritual experiences.
short_description: Spiritual heart of India with ancient riverside ghats, sacred temples, and evening Aarti ceremonies.

name: Sarnath Sacred Buddhist Complex
description: Sarnath is where Gautama Buddha first taught the Dhamma after his enlightenment. It features the Dhamek Stupa, Ashoka Pillar, and serene monasteries.
short_description: Serene pilgrimage site where Lord Buddha gave his first sermon, featuring ancient stupas.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
description: Meenakshi Temple is a historic Hindu temple located on the southern bank of the Vaigai River in Madurai. Dedicated to Meenakshi (Parvati) and Sundareswarar (Shiva), it features 14 colorful gopurams.
short_description: Architectural marvel with 14 soaring gopurams covered in thousands of vibrant sculptures.

name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temples
description: Mahabalipuram is famous for its 7th- and 8th-century Hindu monuments carved out of rock along the Coromandel coast, including the Shore Temple and Pancha Rathas.
short_description: UNESCO rock-cut coastal temples, monolith sculptures, and ancient maritime history.

name: Pichavaram Mangrove Forest
description: Pichavaram is one of the largest mangrove forests in India, offering boat rides through narrow water canals beneath dense canopy trees.
short_description: Second largest mangrove forest in the world offering boat rides through green water tunnels.

name: Gateway of India & Marine Drive
description: The Gateway of India is an arch-monument built in the early 20th century in Mumbai. Nearby Marine Drive offers a C-shaped promenade along the coast, illuminated beautifully at night.
short_description: Iconic seafront archway and Queens Necklace coastal promenade in bustling Mumbai.

name: Ajanta & Ellora Caves
description: Ajanta and Ellora Caves are ancient rock-cut cave monuments featuring Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain carvings, including the monolithic Kailasa Temple.
short_description: Magnificent UNESCO rock-cut cave temples showcasing ancient Indian Buddhist and Hindu art.

name: Kaas Plateau Valley of Flowers
description: Kaas Plateau is a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site known for seasonal wildflower blooms that transform the plateau into a carpet of vibrant colors in late monsoon.
short_description: UNESCO heritage plateau blooming with thousands of rare wild floral species after monsoons.

name: Lonavala & Khandala Western Ghats
description: Lonavala and Khandala are twin hill stations in the Sahyadri range of Maharashtra. Famous for misty waterfalls, Bhaja caves, and Karla rock-cut shrines.
short_description: Scenic Western Ghats hill getaway with misty waterfalls, fort viewpoints, and monsoon greenery.

name: Mysore Palace
description: Mysore Palace is an official residence of the Wadiyar dynasty. It is famous for its Indo-Saracenic grandeur, opulent interior halls, and spectacular weekend illumination.
short_description: Opulent royal residence lit by over 100,000 bulbs every weekend evening.

name: Hampi Ruins & Virupaksha Temple
description: Hampi was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 14th century. Located along the Tungabhadra River, it features boulder-strewn landscapes and magnificent temple ruins.
short_description: Surreal boulder landscape filled with sprawling ancient Vijayanagara empire ruins.

name: Coorg Coffee Plantations
description: Coorg (Kodagu) is a rural district in Karnataka known for misty hill ranges, coffee estates, waterfalls, and Kodava warrior culture.
short_description: Misty hill station surrounded by fragrant coffee plantations and cascades.

name: Agumbe Rainforest Eco-Zone
description: Agumbe is a high-altitude rainforest village known as the Cherrapunji of the South, home to King Cobras, medicinal plants, and spectacular sunset points.
short_description: Dense Western Ghats rainforest sanctuary famous for flora, fauna, and rainy wilderness treks.

name: Kedarnath & Badrinath Temples
description: Kedarnath Temple is a sacred Hindu shrine located in the Himalayas near Mandakini river. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, it is set against majestic snow peaks.
short_description: High-altitude Himalayan holy shrine set amidst magnificent snow peaks.

name: Rishikesh Laxman Jhula & Yoga Ghats
description: Rishikesh is located in the Himalayan foothills beside the Ganges River. Famous as the Yoga Capital of the World, white-water rafting hub, and evening Aarti spot.
short_description: Yoga capital of the world offering spiritual ghats, meditation centers, and river rafting.

name: Valley of Flowers National Park
description: Valley of Flowers is an Indian national park located in North Chamoli in Uttarakhand. It is known for its meadows of endemic alpine flowers and rich flora.
short_description: High-altitude alpine meadow carpeted with endemic wildflowers during monsoon months.

name: Dal Lake & Shikara Rides
description: Dal Lake is a lake in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. It is integral to tourism and recreation in Kashmir and is named the Jewel in the crown of Kashmir.
short_description: Jewel of Srinagar featuring serene shikara boat rides and romantic houseboats.

name: Gulmarg Snow Meadows
description: Gulmarg is a town, hill station, popular skiing destination, and high-altitude gondola ride hub in the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas.
short_description: Premier winter skiing resort with the worlds second-highest gondola ride.

name: Cherrapunji Living Root Bridges
description: Nongriat in Cherrapunji is famous for bio-engineered living root bridges grown by local Khasi tribes across rushing mountain streams.
short_description: Bio-engineered living root bridges crafted by Khasi tribes amidst misty rainforests.

name: Dawki Umngot Crystal River
description: Dawki features the Umngot River, famed for water so clear that boats appear to float on air in mid-water above the pebbled riverbed.
short_description: Glass-like crystal clear river where boats float as if suspended in air.

name: Tsomgo Lake & Nathula Pass
description: Tsomgo Lake is a glacial lake in the East Sikkim district, located at an altitude of 3,753 meters. It changes colors with seasons and remains frozen in winter.
short_description: Glacial high-altitude lake framed by snowy Himalayan peaks near the Indo-China border.

name: Majuli River Island
description: Majuli is the largest river island in the world, located on the Brahmaputra River in Assam. It is the cradle of Assamese Neo-Vaishnavite culture and serene eco-tourism.
short_description: World largest river island featuring ancient Vaishnavite Satras and Assamese folk heritage.

name: Gandikota Grand Canyon
description: Gandikota is a small village in Kadapa district known as the Grand Canyon of India. It features a stunning gorge formed by the Pennar River cutting through Erramala hills.
short_description: Surreal red granite gorge on Pennar river with ancient hilltop fort ramparts.

name: Ziro Valley Pine Meadows
description: Ziro Valley is a picturesque hill station in Arunachal Pradesh, home to the Apatani tribe known for sustainable rice-fish farming and pine-covered hills.
short_description: UNESCO candidate valley with Apatani tribal heritage and lush green paddy fields.

name: Mawlynnong Cleanest Village
description: Mawlynnong is a village in the East Khasi Hills district of Meghalaya. Acclaimed as Asia's Cleanest Village, it offers eco-friendly living and bamboo skywalks.
short_description: Asias cleanest eco-village with living root bridges and manicured flower gardens.

name: Chitrakote Horseshoe Falls
description: Chitrakote Falls is a natural waterfall located on the Indravati River. Known as the Niagara Falls of India due to its broad horseshoe shape in monsoon.
short_description: The Niagara Falls of India featuring a roaring horseshoe cascade on the Indravati river.

name: Orchha Royal Cenotaphs
description: Orchha is a historic town on the banks of Betwa River established by Bundela Rajput chief Rudra Pratap Singh. It is famous for 14 chhatris (cenotaphs) and fort complex.
short_description: Historic medieval riverside town famous for 14 royal cenotaphs and Bundela palaces.

name: Shekhawati Fresco Havelis
description: Shekhawati is an offbeat semi-arid region in Rajasthan known as the Open Air Art Gallery of Rajasthan due to thousands of grand havelis painted with intricate frescoes.
short_description: Open air art gallery region adorned with hundreds of hand-painted royal havelis.

name: Dhanushkodi Ghost Beach
description: Dhanushkodi is an abandoned town on the south-eastern tip of Pamban Island. It is where the Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean waters meet amidst white sands and ruins.
short_description: Surreal abandoned coastal tip where the Indian Ocean meets the Bay of Bengal.

name: Pangi Valley & Killar Cliffs
description: Pangi Valley is a rugged, remote Himalayan valley in Chamba district, known for thrilling cliffside roads, crystal streams, and traditional tribal villages.
short_description: Extreme high-altitude Himalayan valley featuring cliffside trails and unspoiled nature.

name: Tawang Monastery & Sela Pass
description: Tawang Monastery is the largest monastery in India and second largest in the world. Perched at 3,000 meters altitude, it overlooks snow-capped Himalayan peaks.
short_description: High-altitude Buddhist monastery overlooking frozen lakes and Himalayan snow peaks.

name: Gokarna Om Beach & Cliffs
description: Gokarna is a coastal town in Karnataka famous for Om Beach shaped like the sacred symbol Om, palm-fringed cliffs, and laidback beach trekking trails.
short_description: Serene palm-lined coastal cliffs and Om-shaped beach away from crowded tourist hubs.

name: Daringbadi Kashmir of Odisha
description: Daringbadi is a quiet hill station in Kandhamal district of Odisha, known as the Kashmir of Odisha for pine forests, coffee gardens, and occasional frost in winter.
short_description: Scenic Eastern Ghats hill station with pine forests coffee gardens and waterfalls.

name: Mandu Floating Jahaz Mahal
description: Mandu is an ancient fortress city in Madhya Pradesh famous for Afghan architecture, Jahaz Mahal (Ship Palace) situated between two lakes, and romantic folklore.
short_description: Ancient hilltop fortress city with floating palaces and royal Afghan architecture.

name: Yumthang Valley of Flowers
description: Yumthang Valley is a nature sanctuary in North Sikkim with river, hot springs, yaks and grazing pasture on rolling meadows surrounded by Himalayan peaks.
short_description: Valley of Flowers sanctuary in North Sikkim with natural hot springs and alpine meadows.

name: Kumbhalgarh Fort Great Wall
description: Kumbhalgarh Fort is a Mewar fortress on the westerly range of Aravalli Hills. Its perimeter wall extends 36 km, making it the second longest wall in the world.
short_description: Formidable Aravalli fort featuring the 36-km Great Wall of India.

name: Valparai Anamalai Tea Estates
description: Valparai is an offbeat hill station in the Anamalai Hills of the Western Ghats, surrounded by evergreen rainforests, tea estates, and wild macaques.
short_description: Pristine Western Ghats tea country home to lion-tailed macaques and mist-shrouded peaks.

name: Lonar Meteorite Saline Lake
description: Lonar Lake is a National Geo-heritage monument, saline soda lake created by a meteorite impact during the Pleistocene Epoch inside a basalic rock basin.
short_description: Rare hyper-saline soda crater lake created by a prehistoric meteorite impact.
